clue.text: It once was simple to account for

parts.note: ex- describes something that once was, as in ex-wife
plain means simple, unadorned

explanation.surface: Someone recalls that a matter used to be easy to justify.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It once was' reads as part of the sentence, but it stands for EX, the prefix for a former thing.
explanation.definitionFit: To clarify something is to give a reason or account of it.

clue.text: Removal time guaranteed

parts.note: an era is a period of time
sure means certain or guaranteed

explanation.surface: A removal firm promising punctuality.
explanation.definitionFit: The act of rubbing out or deleting something.

clue.text: Having forced a way in, I'd creep around

indicators.note: the letters of I'd creep are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: A burglar describes sneaking around after breaking in.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has punctured or penetrated has pushed through.

clue.text: Roman nose initially put off the scent

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Roman nose initially put off the scent' gives only ROMA (ROMAN less N); the leading A of AROMA has no clue word, so a word such as an initial 'A' seems lost
annotationWithheld.clue: Roman nose initially put off the scent

clue.text: Dark horse disturbing one's rest

parts.note: the night is the dark part of the day
a mare is a female horse

explanation.surface: An unknown racehorse keeps someone awake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dark horse' looks like one idiom for an unknown competitor; it splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A frightening dream is something that ruins sleep.

clue.text: There's no smoke without it!

parts.note: the proverb about fire is twisted: the leaf a smoker puffs is literally what any smoke from a pipe or cigarette needs

explanation.surface: The old proverb that rumours always have some basis in fact.
explanation.walkthrough: The solver hears 'no smoke without fire' and hunts for a fire word; the clue means the dried leaf that a smoker lights.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipe or cigarette yields no smoke unless filled with this dried plant leaf.

clue.text: It turned meaning to stop because exhausted

indicators.note: turned means the word it is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
red is the traffic-light colour that means stop

explanation.surface: Someone halting because they ran out of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhausted means worn out and weary.

clue.text: Vow makes both alter

indicators.note: makes signals that the letters of both alter are made into something new

explanation.surface: A marriage pledge changes both partners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alter' looks like the anagram signal, but it is fodder alongside 'both'.
explanation.definitionFit: An engagement is a mutual promise to marry.

clue.text: Cat is given water in French country-house

parts.note: chat is the French word for cat
eau is the French word for water

explanation.surface: A cat being given a drink of water in a French house.
explanation.definitionFit: A French castle or large country residence.

clue.text: Tedious sort of broadcast

indicators.note: sort here means arrange, so the letters of tedious are sorted

explanation.surface: Complaining that a certain programme is dull.
explanation.walkthrough: An outside broadcast is one made away from the studio, so the definition is a kind of broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: A transmission made on location away from the studio is an outside broadcast.

clue.text: Time to wish for something enduring

parts.note: an age is a period of time
to long is to yearn or wish for something

explanation.surface: A moment to make a wish for something that will last.
explanation.definitionFit: Something lasting for an era or very many years is lasting and permanent.

clue.text: What Luther refused to do about a religious treatise

parts.note: re is a Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning
a tract is a short pamphlet, often on a religious subject

explanation.surface: Martin Luther's stand against the Church over a document he had written.
explanation.walkthrough: At the Diet of Worms in 1521 Martin Luther famously refused to recant his writings, so the definition is a historical allusion.
explanation.definitionFit: Luther would not withdraw or recant his published statements when ordered to.

clue.text: Like some remote regions and unsuccessful pop songs?

definitions.meaning: records that never entered the hit parade, punning on the music charts

explanation.surface: A comparison between unexplored lands and songs that flopped.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the pun: a song that never got into the charts is humorously not on the map.
explanation.definitionFit: Unmapped places and flop records both never appear on a chart, one geographic, one musical.

clue.text: Daggers found in robe lining

indicators.note: the letters are found within the run of the words robe lining

explanation.surface: Weapons concealed in the lining of someone's robe.
explanation.walkthrough: OBELI are the dagger symbols used in printing to mark footnotes, so 'Daggers' is a typographical sense, not weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: The printer's dagger mark (†) is called an obelus, plural obeli.

clue.text: Finish with one's tail in the air

definitions.meaning: to finally arrive somewhere or conclude

definitions.text: with one's tail in the air
definitions.meaning: taken literally, with one's rear end pointed upward

explanation.surface: An animal finishing a race with its tail held high.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to conclude or land somewhere; read literally it puts the rear extremity uppermost.

clue.text: A plan for putting on weight

indicators.note: putting on means one piece goes on before the other

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a gramme is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A diet scheme for gaining weight.
explanation.definitionFit: A schedule or scheme of intended activities.

clue.text: Poor lodgings?

parts.note: not shabby rooms but housing for the poor, provided by charity

explanation.surface: A complaint about inadequate accommodation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poor' looks like a judgment of quality; it means for poor people. An almshouse is a charitable home for the needy, common in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A charitable dwelling built to house needy or elderly people.

clue.text: Nothing to show this is political statement

parts.note: to manifest is to display or show
O is the round shape of zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A remark that there is nothing to display in politics.
explanation.definitionFit: A party's published declaration of its policies.

clue.text: Lead astray

parts.note: not to tempt into sin but to lead a country badly, as a ruler would

explanation.surface: A warning about tempting someone into wrongdoing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead astray' normally means corrupt a person; here it means to rule a state badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruling a nation badly is to direct it the wrong way.

clue.text: Observe a very large lizard

definitions.meaning: to watch or keep under surveillance
the ... lizards, such as the Komodo dragon, are huge reptiles

explanation.surface: An instruction to watch a giant reptile.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping watch over something; also the name of a family of big lizards like the Komodo dragon.

clue.text: Division has FBI agents mounted outside

indicators.note: outside means set goes round the agents

parts.note: a jewel that is mounted is set
G-men is slang for US government agents of the FBI

explanation.surface: A department of the FBI whose agents ride on horseback outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A section or portion of something divided up.

clue.text: Los Angeles has put in for foreign capital

indicators.note: has is put inside the abbreviation for the Californian city

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A city investing money abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Lhasa is the chief city of Tibet, a capital outside Britain.

clue.text: His is a searching examination, by all accounts

definitions.text: His is a searching examination, by all accounts

parts.words: His is a searching examination, by all accounts
parts.note: by all accounts means literally examining every account book, which is this professional's job

explanation.surface: Reports say someone's inspection was thorough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by all accounts' normally means reportedly; here it means through every financial ledger.
explanation.definitionFit: An accountant who inspects a firm's books checks them thoroughly.

clue.text: Antipathy from the gallery

indicators.note: from means the answer is made out of the letters of gallery

explanation.surface: Hostility coming from spectators in the gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: An allergy is, figuratively, a strong aversion or dislike.

clue.text: Troubled reign current in West Africa

indicators.note: a troubled reign is disturbed, so the word reign is rearranged

explanation.surface: Unrest during a monarch's rule in a West African state.
explanation.walkthrough: The Niger is a great river of West Africa, so 'current' means a flowing stream, not something present-day.
explanation.definitionFit: The Niger is the major river flowing through West Africa.

clue.text: It brings down the tone when depressed

definitions.text: It brings down the tone when depressed

parts.words: It brings down the tone when depressed
parts.note: a piano pedal which, when pressed down, makes the sound quieter

explanation.surface: Someone gloomy lowering the mood of a gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brings down the tone' suggests vulgarity and 'depressed' gloom; literally it is a piano pedal that softens the sound when pushed down.
explanation.definitionFit: The left pedal of a piano mutes the volume of notes when pushed.

clue.text: Breakdown in disagreement

definitions.meaning: a break or division into parts
a rift or division in a group

explanation.surface: A collapse of talks during an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: A division into shares is a breakdown; a rift between factions is a disagreement.

clue.text: Quietly show the way to pray

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly
to lead is to show the way

explanation.surface: Guiding someone in silent prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: To beg or entreat earnestly.

clue.text: Glider-pilots find it uplifting

parts.note: uplifting literally: a rising column of warm air that carries a glider upward

explanation.surface: Pilots of gliders enjoying an inspiring experience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uplifting' suggests cheering; literally it is a column of warm rising air.
explanation.definitionFit: A rising current of warm air lets unpowered aircraft gain height.

clue.text: Take it for protection

parts.note: the idiom of taking cover, as from rain or a storm

explanation.surface: Advice to accept something as a safeguard.
explanation.definitionFit: One takes cover from a storm by going under a roof or refuge.

clue.text: Go back and buy another round

definitions.meaning: to stand drinks again, treat everyone a second time

explanation.surface: Returning to the bar to get the next round of drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: Withdrawing is going back; read as re-treat it means paying for drinks once more.

clue.text: Regular soldier?

definitions.meaning: a military attendant who carries out menial duties for an officer or in a hospital

explanation.surface: A question whether a professional soldier is meant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Regular soldier' looks like one phrase, a professional serviceman; it splits into two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat and methodical describes something tidy; an army attendant in a hospital is also so named.
